purpose: Construct the blocked declarative representation of the aggregate Practice operator candidate while preserving its singular identity and exact scientific decisions.

required.statement: Validate the exact feature identity, required opaque input, aggregate source object, canonical provenance, and exact three-reference decision set.
Preserve TLC-SO-PRACTICE-018 as one aggregate object, its input and output identities, payload, reservations, traceability, and scientific decisions.
Keep structural construction, validation, canonical serialization, deserialization, comparison, and trace inspection available despite blocked invocation and evaluation.

forbidden.statement: Do not split the aggregate object into executable internal operators, infer runtime types, implement a body, compose operations, or calculate an output.
Do not alter the exact decisions, invent thresholds, methods, sequences, progressions, effects, or publish partial success.

deferred.statement: Invocation and execution require an external executor; scientific evaluation is deferred to scientific review.

operations.purpose: Return the immutable aggregate operator-candidate representation or a stable structured error.

constraints.statement: The required value is supplied under candidate status and remains opaque.

preconditions.statement: INPUT-PRACTICE-010-1 and the singular aggregate object TLC-SO-PRACTICE-018 are present with canonical provenance.
The scientific decision set is exactly TLC-SO-PRACTICE-018, TLC-SR-PRACTICE-017, and TLC-HR-0108.

postconditions.statement: The aggregate identity, payload, output reference, provenance, reservations, and all three decisions remain exact and traceable.
Blocked invocation and evaluation do not block successful structural representation.

invariants.statement: The source object remains singular and is never silently split into internal executable operations.
The exact three-reference decision set is neither shortened nor extended.
No runtime type, body, composition, output, threshold, progression, or effect is inferred.

steps: validate identity input aggregate provenance and exact decisions
preserve singular identity opaque value and blocker set

partial_order.before: validate identity input aggregate provenance and exact decisions
preserve singular identity opaque value and blocker set

prescription_basis: Aggregate identity, exact blockers, preservation, deterministic structure, and atomic publication are observable; internal sequencing is open.

error_contract.condition: Source error id invalid_feature_identity: the feature id is not TLC-FC-13-PRACTICE-010.
Source error id missing_required_input: INPUT-PRACTICE-010-1 is absent.
Source error id invalid_input_type: the required value is not opaque.
Source error id missing_source_reference: the aggregate object or a decision lacks its canonical reference.
Source error id provenance_mismatch: identity, singular aggregate provenance, or exact decision set differs from authority.
Source error id structural_error: the declarative representation violates this contract.
Source error id scientific_decision_required: scientific evaluation is requested before the exact decisions are resolved.
Source error id external_executor_required: operator invocation or scientific execution is requested without an external executor.
Source error id implementation_out_of_scope: internal operator selection, aggregate splitting, type inference, composition, or output calculation is requested.

implementation_modes.statement: Expose the singular blocked declarative representation and exact decisions.
Do not split, implement, compose, invoke, or evaluate the source aggregate.
Internal architecture remains free when the singular public identity and all observable obligations are preserved.

global_invariants.statement: Blocked operator behavior never invalidates an otherwise valid structural representation.
Aggregate identity, decision identity, candidate status, scientific opacity, and traceability cannot be weakened.

dependencies.purpose: Stable aggregate, input, output, and decision identities

notes: Conformance is structural; aggregate operator semantics remain unresolved.
